mud.en: Landslides and mudslides which can occur after heavy rainfall make earth or mud move downhill very fast.
mud.zh: “Landslides”（山体滑坡）和“mudslides”（泥石流）可能在强降雨后发生，使泥土或泥浆极快地向山下移动。

mud.en: Amid the mud, blood, and sheer senselessness of it all, Fawcett began to question the supposed superiority of Western progress.
mud.zh: 在一片泥泞、血腥和毫无意义的混乱之中，Fawcett 开始质疑西方进步所谓的优越性。

mud.en: Which was… the correct answer! A clay mask, also called a mud pack, is used to smooth the skin on your face.
mud.zh: 答案是……正确答案！粘土面膜，也称为泥膜，用于使脸部皮肤光滑。

mud.en: And it doesn't have to be that overt. You don't have to, the mind mud wrestling with itself is also a problem because I'd love to do that.
mud.zh: 而且这不必表现得那么明显。你不需要——大脑自己跟自己打架也是个问题，因为我其实很喜欢那样做。

mushroom.en: He grew the first mushrooms himself, then listed them for sale on his website.
mushroom.zh: 他自己种植了第一批蘑菇，然后把它们挂在自己的网站上出售。

mushroom.en: For others, it's mushrooms. And worst of all, of course, are Brussels sprouts!
mushroom.zh: 对其他人来说，是蘑菇。当然，最糟糕的是抱子甘蓝！

mushroom.en: Are Death Cap mushrooms: a) brown, b) white, or c) red?
mushroom.zh: 毒鹅膏菌是：a) 棕色，b) 白色，还是 c) 红色？

mushroom.en: That's anything from blackberries and chestnuts to mushrooms and wild garlic.
mushroom.zh: 从黑莓、栗子到蘑菇和野蒜，什么都有。

mushroom.en: So, Ulbricht started with something he knew there would be demand for: drugs, and in particular, magic mushrooms.
mushroom.zh: 因此，Ulbricht 从他知道会有需求的东西开始：毒品，尤其是迷幻蘑菇。

multiple.en: We did it all multiple times in like the span of like three hours.
multiple.zh: 我们在大约3小时内把所有项目都玩了好几遍。

multiple.en: Milgram was shaken. He repeated the experiment multiple times, varying the conditions.
multiple.zh: 米尔格拉姆本人也被震撼到了。他多次重复这项实验，并不断改变实验条件。

multiple.en: People who had never invested in real estate before started buying multiple properties as investments.
multiple.zh: 以前从未投资过房地产的人也开始买入多处房产作为投资。

multiple.en: And banks became increasingly willing to lend larger multiples of people’s incomes.
multiple.zh: 银行也越来越愿意提供相当于人们收入更高倍数的贷款。

multiple.en: But one person with a dog or with multiple dogs is a different kettle of fish.
multiple.zh: 但一个人带着一只狗或好几只狗，情况就完全不同了。

murder.en: For example, it was named by the Norwegian terrorist Anders Breivik, who murdered 77 people in 2011.
murder.zh: 例如，在2011年谋杀77人的挪威恐怖分子Anders Breivik就提到了它。

murder.en: A warrant was issued for Wyatt Earp’s arrest on charges of murder.
murder.zh: 当局发出了逮捕令，以谋杀罪通缉 Wyatt Earp。

murder.en: Most were murdered shortly after they arrived as part of the Holocaust.
murder.zh: 作为大屠杀的一部分，大多数人在抵达后不久就被谋杀了。

murder.en: Guns with scratched-off serial numbers, for example, weapons that were clearly intended to be used for murder.
murder.zh: 例如，被磨掉序列号的枪支，这些武器显然是打算用来谋杀的。

murder.en: In part two, we’ll talk about the daylight murder of Kim Jong-un’s brother in Kuala Lumpur airport.
murder.zh: 在第二集，我们会讲金正恩(Kim Jong-un)的哥哥在吉隆坡机场光天化日之下被杀的事件。

muscle.en: Dogs have a tiny muscle above their eyes that wolves simply do not have.
muscle.zh: 狗的眼睛上方有一块微小的肌肉，而狼身上根本没有这块肌肉。

muscle.en: Babies have to learn to use their mouth muscles to make specific sounds.
muscle.zh: 宝宝必须学会使用他们的口腔肌肉来发出特定的声音。

muscle.en: And so like the stick to it muscle is the one that you have to flex.
muscle.zh: 所以，“坚持下去”这种肌肉是你必须去锻炼的。

muscle.en: So, mental clarity, gut health, muscle development, these sorts of things.
muscle.zh: 因此，精神清晰度、肠道健康、肌肉发育，诸如此类。

muscle.en: And finally, a shiver is the shaking movement made by your muscles when you feel cold or afraid.
muscle.zh: 最后，shiver（发抖）是指当你感到寒冷或害怕时，肌肉做出的颤抖动作。

museum.en: From the British Museum’s perspective, their Moai statue is an important part of global heritage.
museum.zh: 从大英博物馆的角度来看，他们的 Moai 雕像是全球遗产的重要组成部分。

museum.en: Victoria Reed is senior curator at the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston.
museum.zh: 维多利亚·里德是波士顿美术博物馆的高级策展人。

museum.en: According to the Natural History Museum of Utah, four out of every five wildfires are manmade.
museum.zh: 根据犹他州自然历史博物馆的数据，每五场野火中就有四场是人为造成的。

museum.en: Well, as the final destination for much looted treasure, museums have an important role to play.
museum.zh: 嗯，作为许多被掠夺宝藏的最终目的地，博物馆扮演着重要的角色。

museum.en: Should museums have the right to keep objects taken during periods of inequality or colonial rule?
museum.zh: 博物馆是否有权保留在不平等或殖民统治时期掠夺来的物品？

musical.en: But I have a fixed mindset in things like my musical and artistic ability.
musical.zh: 但在音乐和艺术能力等方面，我有着固定型思维。

musical.en: We've all heard of geniuses who produce great works of literature or magnificent musical compositions.
musical.zh: 我们都听说过那些创作出伟大文学作品或壮丽音乐作品的天才。

musical.en: Samba is perhaps Brazil’s most famous musical style, and that developed from African rhythms and religious celebrations.
musical.zh: 桑巴或许是巴西最著名的音乐风格，它就是从非洲节奏和宗教庆典中发展而来的。

musical.en: The one who lost America. The one in the musical Hamilton, as a comic, petulant villain who sings about how the colonists will come crawling back to him.
musical.zh: 那个丢了美洲的人。那个在音乐剧《Hamilton》里出场的人，是一个滑稽、任性的反派，唱着殖民者会如何摇尾乞怜地回到他身边。

musical.en: But the right way to think about it is: How much does a person have to work to be able to, say, read at night, or watch a play, a musical, at night?
musical.zh: 正确的思考方式应该是：一个人需要工作多久，才能负担得起比如说晚上读书，或者晚上看一场戏剧、一场音乐剧？

mutual.en: The way it worked was that a small bank, like Silver State Mortgage where Mike Garner worked, would borrow money from a big bank, say Citibank or Washington Mutual.
mutual.zh: 它的运作方式是，像迈克·加纳工作的白银州抵押贷款公司（Silver State Mortgage）这样的小银行，会从花旗银行或华盛顿互惠银行这样的大银行借钱。

mutual.en: So the only way you can remain in flow is if you get either very good at ignoring these things by default or closing yourself off like a hermit, like our mutual friend Tim Ferriss does.
mutual.zh: 所以你保持心流的唯一方法是，要么你非常擅长默认忽略这些事情，要么像我们的共同朋友 Tim Ferriss 那样把自己封闭起来，像个隐士一样。

mutual.en: He argues that cooking may have been one of the early drivers of pair bonding, of a more stable relationship between a man and a woman, based less on romantic love than on mutual advantage.
mutual.zh: 他认为，烹饪可能是男女之间建立伴侣关系、建立更稳定关系的早期推动力之一，这种关系更多地基于共同利益，而不是浪漫爱情。

murderer.en: Yes, someone prepared to kill, a murderer.
murderer.zh: 是的，这是一个随时准备杀戮的凶手。

murderer.en: To their surprise, there was no scar. The man was not Lord Lucan, but if he wasn’t the disappeared suspected murderer, who was he?
murderer.zh: 令他们惊讶的是，没有疤痕。这人不是 Lord Lucan，但如果他不是那个失踪的杀人嫌犯，那他是谁？

murderer.en: In the newspapers of the Southwest, he had been reported as a murderer: a man who had used his badge to pursue a private vendetta and then fled justice.
murderer.zh: 在美国西南部的报纸上，他曾被报道成一个杀人凶手：一个借警徽之名追求私人复仇、事后又逃避法律制裁的人。

murderer.en: And there's a scripture that talks about some of you were thieves, some of you were murderers, some of you were tax evaders, and some of you were men who lied with men.
murderer.zh: 有一段经文提到，你们当中有些人曾是小偷，有些人曾是谋杀犯，有些人曾是逃税者，还有些人曾是与男人苟合的男人。

mustard.en: This isn’t really true. British cooking historically used loads of spices: black pepper, ginger, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves, mustard, and mace.
mustard.zh: 这并不完全属实。英国烹饪在历史上使用了大量的香料：黑胡椒、生姜、肉豆蔻、肉桂、丁香、芥末和肉豆蔻皮。

mustard.en: A roast joint of beef would usually just be seasoned with salt and pepper, some herbs as well, and then served with vegetables and gravy and perhaps horseradish or mustard.
mustard.zh: 一大块烤牛肉通常只用盐、胡椒和一些草药调味，然后搭配蔬菜、肉汁，或许还有辣根或芥末一起食用。

mustard.en: The message was clear: to “Make America Great Again”, lazy federal employees needed to pick up the pace, and the waste and inefficiency that had been tolerated under previous administrations, both Democratic and Republican, was no longer going to cut the mustard.
mustard.zh: 信息很明确：为了“让美国再次伟大”，懒散的联邦雇员需要加快步伐，而历届政府（无论是民主党还是共和党）一直容忍的浪费和低效将不再管用。

muse.en: Elon Musk was one of the guests. As the evening went on, Musk started musing on the idea of radically reducing the size of the federal government.
muse.zh: Elon Musk 是嘉宾之一。随着夜渐深，Musk 开始沉思彻底缩减联邦政府规模的想法。

muse.en: Perhaps, he mused, the true measure of civilisation wasn’t bombs and factories, and industrial output, but wisdom and harmony—qualities that might lie undiscovered beneath the rainforest’s thick foliage.
muse.zh: 他沉思着，或许文明真正的标尺不是炸弹、工厂和工业产出，而是智慧与和谐——这些品质或许正静静地躺在雨林厚重枝叶下，等待着被发掘。

mutter.en: There was Sarah Good, a beggar who smoked a pipe and muttered under her breath when anyone refused her charity.
mutter.zh: 其中有萨拉·古德（Sarah Good），一个抽着烟斗的乞丐，当别人拒绝她的施舍时，她会在嘴里嘟嘟囔囔。

murmur.en: And before there are murmurs about how this Amendment could be overturned, and Donald Trump’s throwaway comments about running for a third term, it would be immensely difficult for this to happen, and to my knowledge, no serious commentator has ever entertained this as a possibility.
murmur.zh: 在有人小声议论这个修正案如何被推翻、以及唐纳德·特朗普关于竞选第三任期的随口言论之前，要让这种情况发生是极其困难的，而且据我所知，没有哪个严肃的评论员会把这当成一种可能。

musician.en: I was like, this is incredible. And you were heavily into interviewing musicians back then.
musician.zh: 当时我就觉得，这太不可思议了。你那时候非常热衷于采访音乐人。

musician.en: I've seen you talk to a ton of musicians and artists on camera.
musician.zh: 我见过你在镜头前和无数音乐家和艺术家交谈。

musician.en: Low living costs and large open spaces attracted artists and musicians, migrants from around the world.
musician.zh: 低廉的生活成本和宽敞的开放空间吸引了来自世界各地的艺术家、音乐家和移民。

musician.en: He's halfway between a warrior and a savant and an artist and a musician and everything rolled together.
musician.zh: 他介于战士、天才、艺术家和音乐家之间，集所有特质于一身。

mug.en: I spent far too many days trying to design a T-shirt or a mug or a notebook to sell on my website.
mug.zh: 我花了太多天时间试图设计一件 T 恤、一个马克杯或一本笔记本在我的网站上出售。

multiplication.en: While most children were learning simple addition and multiplication, Ramanujan was already exploring complex ideas entirely on his own.
multiplication.zh: 当大多数孩子还在学习简单的加法和乘法时，Ramanujan就已经完全靠自己探索复杂的思想了。

multitude.en: That's fake. There are a multitude of ways to discuss any issue and any topic.
multitude.zh: 那是假的。讨论任何议题和话题都有多种方式。

multiply.en: Just the amount of sheer work, like the biggest change in, or I'll say biggest reason that I've had significantly larger returns or outcomes that have happened later on in my career and they continue to get bigger and bigger is because the minimum standard for how much work I know I can do on something has multiplied a hundredfold.
multiply.zh: 仅仅是纯粹的工作量，我职业生涯后期获得巨大回报或成果的最大原因，就是我知道自己在某件事上可以投入的工作量的最低标准已经翻了一百倍。

municipal.en: So, most of modern history, what they did was they bought really safe and, frankly, really boring investments like treasuries and municipal bonds, boring things.
municipal.zh: 因此，在现代历史的大部分时间里，他们的做法是购买真正安全、坦率地说也真的很无聊的投资，比如国债和市政债券，这些枯燥的东西。
